brief: Holds the five rules a family tree is judged by: no one is their own ancestor, a union has two partners, a child has one union, parents are older, partners are not kin.
detail: Check takes the rule graph of a tree (AsRuleGraph) and answers the findings. A tree asks for this through its own GovernanceFindings, so a rule set is built by hand only to add a rule of your own or to run the rules on a graph. A single parent, a union with one partner, is a warning and not an error.
